shared_elements: human head with facial features (eyes, nose, mouth)
frontal or profile depiction of the body
justification: Both surfaces depict human figures, but A is a flat, low-relief stele with registers of small profile figures accompanied by signs and standing objects/emblems, while B is a fully three-dimensional figure (or stacked figures) with a large modelled head, incised cap and modelled shoulders and arms. Beyond the generic presence of human beings, there is no shared specific motif, relationship or compositional scheme: A organises many small figures into horizontal bands facing one another, B presents a single massive frontal head-and-torso in the round.
